changelog.entry: Messages now arrive one at a time, when you tap, by default (Settings still has All at once). Harbour is no longer perfect: three replies on days 2, 4 and 6 show a habit of saying it will be fine before listening, and on day 7 you can own it, which colours a few endings. A tenth ending, Left in the Window, is sadder but gentle (nobody is lost; reach it by accepting Bit's battery on day 9 and asking what Bit needs on day 11). Harbour's one-line log note at the start of each day is now text only and off until you switch it on in Settings.

Stranded opens: a branching text conversation with Ines, a stubborn, funny field engineer alone on a small moon. Twelve days, fifty-nine scenes, nine endings, and every reply gets an answer. Rewind to any of your messages for free, and nothing you found or tried is ever lost. Nothing is timed: replies appear at once, or one at a time when you tap. Trust, Supplies and Hope are always in view.
